title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Premium Revision Paper #16

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which surah is the last surah of the Qur'an? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Ikhlas
   B. Al-Falaq
   C. Al-Fatiha
   D. An-Naas

2. What do we ask Allah for in the sixth verse of Al-Fatiha? (1 mark)
   A. To make us win games
   B. To give us money
   C. To make us famous
   D. To guide us to the straight path

3. Which of these is a good way to learn the correct sounds of a surah? (1 mark)
   A. Learn only by writing
   B. Read as fast as possible
   C. Guess from English letters only
   D. Listen to a teacher or good reciter and repeat

4. What does "Qul a'udhu" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Say: I forgive
   B. Say: I seek refuge
   C. Say: I worship
   D. Say: I thank

5. Why did people leave their valuables with Muhammad (S.A.W.) before Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Because they trusted him
   B. Because he was the richest
   C. Because he was afraid
   D. Because he lived in the mountain

6. Which job did the young Muhammad (S.A.W.) do? (1 mark)
   A. Judge
   B. Soldier
   C. Shepherd and later trader
   D. Blacksmith only

7. What should we say before brushing? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing
   B. Goodbye
   C. Amin only
   D. Bismillah

8. Which of these is a good time to use the siwak? (1 mark)
   A. Never
   B. Before wudhu and prayer
   C. Only in winter
   D. Only at weddings

9. Who recorded the syllabus hadith about brushing teeth? (1 mark)
   A. Abu Lahab
   B. Khadija
   C. Ibn Majah, according to the syllabus
   D. Waraqa

10. What should you do when the adhan is called during a game? (1 mark)
   A. Turn off the radio
   B. Continue the game
   C. Stop, make wudhu and pray
   D. Ask for extra time

11. How does physical fitness help worship? (1 mark)
   A. It replaces zakat
   B. It makes prayer shorter
   C. It makes standing, bowing and fasting easier
   D. It removes the need to pray

12. What does the word "attribute" mean? (1 mark)
   A. A place
   B. A quality that describes someone
   C. A type of food
   D. A prayer

13. What is our response to Allah's mercy? (1 mark)
   A. Be merciful to people, animals and the environment
   B. Be harsh
   C. Ignore others
   D. Be proud

14. Which name reminds us that Allah hears our dua? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Malik
   B. Ar-Rahman
   C. Al-Basir
   D. As-Sami'

15. Which two names come from the word "rahmah"? (1 mark)
   A. As-Sami' and Al-Basir
   B. Al-Malik and As-Salam
   C. Ar-Rahman and Al-Malik
   D. Ar-Rahman and Ar-Rahim

16. Which prophet is famous for patience during illness? (1 mark)
   A. Dawud
   B. Yusuf
   C. Hud
   D. Ayyub

17. Prophet Nuh called his people to Allah for how long? (1 mark)
   A. 100 days
   B. 9 years
   C. 950 years
   D. 50 years

18. Eid al-Adha reminds us of the obedience of (1 mark)
   A. Adam and Hawa
   B. Musa and Harun
   C. Ibrahim and Ismail
   D. Nuh and Lut

19. Which is physical purity? (1 mark)
   A. Removing envy from the heart
   B. Washing off urine from clothes
   C. Saying sorry
   D. Giving charity

20. What is a good habit for cleaning after using the toilet? (1 mark)
   A. Use nothing
   B. Leave it
   C. Use water and wash hands with soap
   D. Skip washing

21. What is the meaning of niyyah? (1 mark)
   A. Intention in the heart
   B. Direction
   C. Prayer times
   D. Prayer mat

22. Which prayer has two rak'ahs? (1 mark)
   A. Maghrib
   B. Dhuhr
   C. Fajr
   D. Asr

23. What is a mihrab? (1 mark)
   A. The niche in a mosque showing the Qibla
   B. A prayer time
   C. A type of clothes
   D. A cap

24. How many daily prayers are there? (1 mark)
   A. Seven
   B. Five
   C. Three
   D. Ten

25. What is ruku? (1 mark)
   A. Prostrating
   B. Sitting
   C. Standing
   D. Bowing

26. How many parts of the body touch the ground in sujud? (1 mark)
   A. Three
   B. Seven
   C. Two
   D. Five

27. What is a benefit of the Islamic dress code? (1 mark)
   A. More harm
   B. Dignity and protection
   C. Waste
   D. Loss of respect

28. Why should clothes not carry rude words or pictures? (1 mark)
   A. They disrespect faith and others
   B. They are heavy
   C. They are cheap
   D. They fade

29. What is assertiveness in dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Copying everyone
   B. Insulting others
   C. Politely standing by how you dress because of faith
   D. Shouting

30. What should you do if a stranger online asks for your address? (1 mark)
   A. Send a photo
   B. Refuse and tell an adult
   C. Give it
   D. Tell friends

31. Which of these is a positive use of the internet? (1 mark)
   A. Bullying
   B. Meeting strangers
   C. Watching harmful videos
   D. Finding information for a school project with permission

32. Which is a negative use of media? (1 mark)
   A. Calling grandmother
   B. Studying
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Listening to Qur'an

33. Which of these is a mobile phone use that follows Islamic manners? (1 mark)
   A. Playing during prayer
   B. Sharing private photos
   C. Calling a relative to greet them
   D. Sending unkind messages

34. What is begging? (1 mark)
   A. Saving
   B. Working
   C. Asking for money or things without real need
   D. Farming

35. What is one reward of being good to parents? (1 mark)
   A. Trouble
   B. Blessing and Allah's pleasure
   C. Loss
   D. Nothing

36. What does "lower the wing of humility" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Fly
   B. Shout
   C. Be gentle and humble to them
   D. Ignore them

37. Why are parents to be respected? (1 mark)
   A. They are rich
   B. They are old only
   C. They are tall
   D. They sacrifice time, energy and money for us

38. Which verse tells us to fear Allah and respect family ties? (1 mark)
   A. Qur'an 110:3
   B. Qur'an 1:2
   C. Qur'an 4:1
   D. Qur'an 112:1

39. Who is a "mjomba"? (1 mark)
   A. Father's sister
   B. Grandmother
   C. Cousin
   D. Mother's brother

40. What should you do if you fail a test? (1 mark)
   A. Study more and try again
   B. Give up
   C. Blame others
   D. Cheat

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write the pillars of swalah from ruku up to taslim. (5 marks)

42. Match each surah with one lesson: Al-Fatiha, Al-Kafirun, An-Nasr and Al-Ikhlas. (4 marks)

43. Explain the rule when you are unsure whether wudhu broke. (3 marks)

44. Distinguish between physical and spiritual purity. (3 marks)

45. State two lessons from Surah An-Nasr. (2 marks)

46. Write a short thank-you note to a parent with two promises about helping at home. (5 marks)

47. What lesson do we learn from Surah Al-Masad? (3 marks)

48. Why are Al-Falaq and An-Naas called the two surahs of seeking refuge? (3 marks)

49. Why is Laylat al-Qadr connected to the first revelation? (3 marks)

50. Describe what the Prophet (S.A.W.) did every night before sleeping with Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Naas. (3 marks)

51. Why do Muslims all over the world face the Qibla? (4 marks)

52. Explain tawakkul using an example. (3 marks)

53. List the steps of brushing teeth correctly. (3 marks)

54. Describe how to clean a medium najasa on a mat. (3 marks)

55. Give three manners of making dua. (3 marks)

56. What warning did the Prophet give about cutting family ties? (3 marks)

57. Explain what Qur'an 17:23-24 teaches about treating parents. (3 marks)

58. Describe how a class can show kindness to creatures in the school compound. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — An-Naas
   An-Naas is number 114, the last surah.

2. D — To guide us to the straight path
   The verse is "Guide us to the straight path".

3. D — Listen to a teacher or good reciter and repeat
   Correct Arabic sounds must be learned by listening to a teacher.

4. B — Say: I seek refuge
   Both protection surahs begin with these words.

5. A — Because they trusted him
   He was called Al-Amin.

6. C — Shepherd and later trader
   He herded sheep and later traded honestly.

7. D — Bismillah
   Bismillah is said before good acts.

8. B — Before wudhu and prayer
   The Prophet encouraged it before prayers.

9. C — Ibn Majah, according to the syllabus
   The syllabus names Ibn Majah.

10. C — Stop, make wudhu and pray
   Prayer must not be delayed by play.

11. C — It makes standing, bowing and fasting easier
   A healthy body helps us do our duties.

12. B — A quality that describes someone
   An attribute is a quality, like kindness.

13. A — Be merciful to people, animals and the environment
   Mercy received should be shown.

14. D — As-Sami'
   As-Sami' hears whispers and silent prayers.

15. D — Ar-Rahman and Ar-Rahim
   Rahmah means mercy.

16. D — Ayyub
   Ayyub was tested with illness and stayed patient.

17. C — 950 years
   Qur'an 29:14 mentions 950 years.

18. C — Ibrahim and Ismail
   It remembers the sacrifice of a ram.

19. B — Washing off urine from clothes
   Physical purity concerns body, clothes and place.

20. C — Use water and wash hands with soap
   Water is best.

21. A — Intention in the heart
   Niyyah is intention.

22. C — Fajr
   Fajr has two.

23. A — The niche in a mosque showing the Qibla
   It marks the direction of prayer.

24. B — Five
   There are five.

25. D — Bowing
   Ruku is bowing.

26. B — Seven
   Forehead, two palms, two knees, toes of both feet.

27. B — Dignity and protection
   Modest dress protects a person.

28. A — They disrespect faith and others
   Clothes should be modest.

29. C — Politely standing by how you dress because of faith
   You calmly explain.

30. B — Refuse and tell an adult
   Strangers can be unsafe.

31. D — Finding information for a school project with permission
   Learning is good.

32. C — Spreading rumours
   Rumours can hurt.

33. C — Calling a relative to greet them
   Keeping ties is good.

34. C — Asking for money or things without real need
   Begging is asking without need.

35. B — Blessing and Allah's pleasure
   It is among the best deeds.

36. C — Be gentle and humble to them
   Be humble.

37. D — They sacrifice time, energy and money for us
   Gratitude.

38. C — Qur'an 4:1
   Surah An-Nisa 4:1.

39. D — Mother's brother
   Mjomba is mother's brother.

40. A — Study more and try again
   Perseverance.

SECTION B
----
41. (5 marks)
   Answer: Ruku, rising from ruku, sujud, sitting between the sujud, last sitting, tashahhud, blessings on the Prophet, taslim.
   Working / marking points: Award 1 mark for each two correct pillars up to 4 and 1 mark for correct order.

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: Al-Fatiha: praise Allah and ask for guidance; Al-Kafirun: stay firm in faith; An-Nasr: thank Allah when you succeed; Al-Ikhlas: Allah is One.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct pair.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: If you were sure you made wudhu and only doubt it broke, you remain in wudhu, because certainty is not removed by doubt.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for staying in wudhu, 1 mark for certainty, 1 mark for the example.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Physical purity is cleaning body, clothes and place from najasaat. Spiritual purity is cleaning the heart from envy, pride and hatred.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for physical, 1 mark for spiritual, 1 mark for an example.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: We should thank Allah and be humble when we succeed, and ask His forgiveness.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each lesson.

46. (5 marks)
   Answer: A polite note thanking the parent for specific things, and two clear promises such as washing dishes and doing homework early.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for greeting and thanks, 2 marks for specific thanks, 2 marks for two promises.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wealth and family connections cannot save a person who refuses the truth and harms good people. We should avoid pride and harm.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for wealth cannot save, 1 mark for harming others is wrong, 1 mark for avoiding pride.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: Both begin with "Qul a'udhu", meaning "Say: I seek refuge". In them we ask Allah to protect us from harm.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the opening words, 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for protection.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: The Qur'an says it was sent down on the Night of Power in Ramadan, which is why Ramadan is special.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the Night of Power, 1 mark for Ramadan, 1 mark for the Qur'an.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: He joined his hands, blew into them, recited the three surahs and wiped his body with his hands.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for blowing into the hands, 1 mark for the three surahs, 1 mark for wiping the body.

51. (4 marks)
   Answer: Allah commanded it in the Qur'an (2:144). It unites Muslims and shows that we worship one Lord.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for command, 1 mark for the verse or Kaaba, 1 mark for unity, 1 mark for one Lord.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: Tawakkul is doing our part and then trusting Allah, for example taking an umbrella and saying the dua before leaving.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for example, 1 mark for trust in Allah.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: Say Bismillah, use a pea-sized amount of paste, brush outer, inner and chewing surfaces, brush the tongue, rinse and store the brush.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct group of steps up to 3.

54. (3 marks)
   Answer: Remove the substance, pour water until the colour, smell and taste have gone, then dry.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for removal, 1 mark for washing until traces go, 1 mark for drying.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: Begin with praise, face the Qibla and raise hands, be humble, be patient, say Amin.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: The one who cuts family ties will not enter Paradise. So we should keep ties strong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the warning, 1 mark for the meaning, 1 mark for the lesson.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: Do not say "uff", speak kindly, be humble and make dua for them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of three teachings.

58. (4 marks)
   Answer: Plant and water trees, put out water for birds, keep the compound clean, do not harm insects and animals.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid action.
